title: Weekly review: Friday showcase
positioning: Quiet Desk's promise of calm, concrete habits applied to the end of the week: a small ritual instead of a productivity system.

context.audience: Solo founders and freelancers who end most weeks unsure what mattered
context.promise: End Friday knowing exactly what Monday needs, in 15 minutes

caption:
Most weeks don't end. They just stop.

A 15-minute review on Friday fixes that:
1. Empty every inbox into one list
2. Ask three questions about the week
3. Pick Monday's one task and write it on paper

Save this for Friday afternoon.

Follow @quietdesk.demo for one calm work habit, every Tuesday.

content.idea: A weekly review can take 15 minutes and fix Monday
content.headline: Your weekly review, in 15 minutes
content.key: Three short steps to end Friday knowing exactly what Monday needs.

content.headline: Empty every inbox
content.key: Email, tabs, notes, sticky notes. Move it all into one list.
content.support: The rule: capture now, act on nothing yet.

content.headline: Look back first
content.key: Three questions. Last week becomes lessons.

content.idea: Decide Monday's single priority on Friday
content.headline: Pick Monday's one task
content.key: Write it on paper and leave it on your keyboard.
content.support: Monday starts with the decision already made.

content.headline: Follow for calmer weeks
content.support: One calm work habit, every Tuesday.

plan.why: a few cards and one word: the word sits behind, cards drift around it
move: rig.phase one cycle: keeps every card drifting on its own slow loop
camera dolly in and back: keeps the frame alive
